artworks.title: Ruins on the Palatine with the Septizonium
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.8 x 28.5 cm (7 13/16 x 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with ancient ruins. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a wide view of the scene. The horizon blends with the sky where there are softly drawn clouds. The ruins are detailed, featuring weathered stone structures with arches and remnants of columns. The style seems like etching with fine lines for texture and shading. The color scheme is mainly sepia-toned, creating a historical look. Close by, scattered stones and plants are seen, hinting at abandonment. In the distance, the ruins extend, partly covered by foliage, indicating a once grand setting that is now overgrown.

artworks.title: Ruins on the Palatine with a Panoramic Landscape
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.3 x 28.1 cm (8 x 11 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins captured from an elevated viewpoint with a horizon marked by distant mountains and a sun casting rays across the sky. In the distance, there are ruins and old structures, with detailed remnants of architecture in the foreground, surrounded by foliage. The scene is depicted with cross-hatching and fine lines, creating a delicate etching-like appearance. The monochromatic palette emphasizes details and contrast, while clouds fill the sky above.

artworks.title: Ruins on the Palatine, Looking toward the Baths of Caracalla
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23 x 33 cm (9 1/16 x 13 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin with intricate details. The perspective is close, emphasizing the remnants of the old building or fortress. The sky is filled with cloud lines and mountains are visible in the distance, creating a sense of depth. The ruins are carefully depicted with a weathered and textured surface, with vegetation growing on them. The etching style uses long, linear strokes to create texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and sepia for contrast and depth. The scene also includes fields, smaller buildings, and distant structures, all engraved in detail.

artworks.title: The Basilica of Constantine
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.8 x 28.8 cm (9 x 11 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with intricate architectural details, partially covered in vegetation. The stone structure features archways and brickwork with precise lines. The color scheme is sepia, giving an aged feel. Human figures are depicted near the ruins, engaging in various activities. The background shows a lightly sketched sky with sparse clouds.

artworks.title: The Temple of Augustus and Faustina, the Temple of Divus Romulus, and the Basilica of Constantine
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.4 x 32.9 cm (8 13/16 x 12 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows ancient Roman ruins captured from a slightly elevated perspective. The ruins include towering arches, a rectangular building with a bell tower, and intricate engravings. The artwork features a monochromatic color palette with varying shades of sepia or brown. Figures can be seen near the ruins, and in the distance, smaller structures and a possible city skyline are visible. The sky above is textured with clouds.

artworks.title: The Septizonium and the Colosseum
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.4 x 32 cm (8 13/16 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts ancient ruins resembling Roman architecture dominating the center and right side of the composition. The ruins show columns and arches with vegetation growing from them. The horizon is near the upper edge, with hills or mountains in the distance. The sky has soft clouds, and the artwork features precise linework and shading, creating a detailed texture. The color palette is monochromatic using varying intensities of black ink. Two small figures are near the ruins, and in the distance, sparse vegetation and distant structures can be seen.

artworks.title: The Baths of Diocletian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.4 x 33.6 cm (9 3/16 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etched view of ancient ruins, possibly the Baths of Diocletian. The ruins dominate the scene with detailed stone textures under swirling clouds. Birds fly in the distance. The monochrome color palette emphasizes the form and texture of the ruins. Figures add scale to the architecture. Vegetation grows on the structure.

artworks.title: Second View of the Baths of Diocletian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.9 x 30.8 cm (8 5/8 x 12 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts ancient Roman ruins, specifically arches of a structure. The view is slightly elevated, showing the ruins overlooking hills in the distant landscape. The arches show decay, with missing bricks and vegetation growing between them. The style is detailed linework and hatching, reminiscent of etching or engraving, in a monochromatic brown ink palette. The focus is on the textures and depths of the ruins and surrounding nature. In the background, more structures or ruins can be seen, blending with the clouds. Close by, scattered rocks and patches of grass contribute to the sense of abandonment.

artworks.title: View of the Baths of Caracalla
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.5 x 30.2 cm (8 7/8 x 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows crumbling ruins of stone structures from a slightly elevated perspective. The ruins dominate the scene, depicted in a detailed, linear style with a monochromatic color scheme. Plants are growing on and around the structures. In the distance, faint outlines of more ruins or distant structures can be seen against the sky.

artworks.title: View of the Forum from the Base of the Capitol
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.4 x 32.9 cm (9 3/16 x 12 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape filled with ruins. The horizon is low, the sky is cloudy with birds flying. There are ancient structures, figures in robes, and grand architectural elements like an arch and temple ruins with tall columns. Historical buildings and towers are in the background. The artwork is an engraving with intricate lines and a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: View of the Forum of Nerva
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.9 x 30.3 cm (7 7/16 x 11 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of ancient Roman ruins from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The composition focuses on the ruins extending vertically upward. The scene contains remnants of grand architecture, with tall, fluted columns partially intact, supporting fragments of what were once robust structures. The etching demonstrates precise and detailed linework, with intricate cross-hatching and shading that emphasize the texture and deterioration of the ruins. Close to us, there are scattered stones and fragments that hint at the decay over time. Beyond, figures are seen walking, giving a sense of scale and activity within this historical context. The background fades behind detailed architectural elements such as the archways and partial roof lines. The palette is essentially monochromatic, relying on the play of light, shadow, and line to convey form and depth.

artworks.title: Second View of the Forum of Nerva
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.2 x 33.1 cm (9 1/8 x 13 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of ancient Roman ruins from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the image with remnants of classical architecture reaching towards it. The etching features intricate brushstrokes depicting lines and cross-hatching for texture and dimension. The palette consists of various shades of brown for depth and contrast. Two figures are shown in conversation among the ruins, with stone columns and crumbling walls nearby. More ruins lead to a distant, more intact structure, partially obscured by rough terrain. Small plants grow from the ancient stones, suggesting nature reclaiming its space. The sky is lightly sketched with a few clouds to enhance the historical atmosphere of the etching.

artworks.title: View of Unidentified Ruins
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.7 x 28.5 cm (8 15/16 x 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient and partially ruined structure from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is low, with parts of the structure occupying the space. The artwork is an etching with detailed lines and hatching for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown. The ground has stones and plants, leading to the larger ruins. In the distance, there are sparse vegetation and trees framing the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Landscape with Ruins
artworks.artist: Hieronymus Cock after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.8 x 35.1 cm (9 x 13 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts classical ruins viewed from an almost eye-level point. The horizon is set high in the composition, suggesting a vast landscape with grand edifices. A figure is bent over a book among overgrown vegetation and stone debris. Classical columns, arches, and a statue are prominent in the middle. In the distance, there are more structures and small human figures. The intricate linework and cross-hatching convey texture, while the monochrome palette emphasizes contrasts and complements detailed patterns.

artworks.title: Preparations for the Lying in State of Edward VII
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Robert G. Cleveland
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with structural details and human activity. The artwork depicts a hall with a vaulted ceiling featuring arches. Rows of statues stand on pedestals along the walls. The floor is lively with figures engaged in various activities, including what appears to be construction work. The perspective of the drawing accentuates the height and vastness of the interior, with a large window at the far end that suggests Gothic architecture.

artworks.title: Meine Mutter (My Mother)
artworks.description: The image is a head and shoulders portrait of a woman facing slightly to the right. She has arched eyebrows, a smooth forehead, and a slight smile. Her hair is mostly covered by a headscarf. She is dressed in dark clothing. The background is dark, creating a contrast with her face and upper body. Below the image, the text "MEINE MUTTER" is written. The etching is on light-colored paper with a margin surrounding the central image.

artworks.title: Mother and Child
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jill Newhouse in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image features a woman holding a child. The woman stands upright with her body facing forward and head slightly turned down towards the child. She has a calm expression, long hair, and wears a flowing robe. The child is securely held and gazes towards the viewer. In the background, there is an arch with decorative designs on either side.

artworks.title: Apollo and the Cumaean Sibyl
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman and another figure with a lyre in a natural setting. The woman stands reaching out towards the seated figure who holds a lyre. The scene is set amidst lush foliage and a dramatic, cloud-filled sky. The drawing exhibits fine lines and meticulous detailing typical of classical style.

artworks.title: Polichinelle
artworks.medium: 7-color lithograph on bright white wove paper (second edition)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a walking pose. The person has a large nose, pronounced mouth, raised eyebrows, and a smirk. They wear a large hat with ornate detailing and colorful garments including a ruffled collar, a patterned vest, puffed sleeves, knee-length pants, boots, and hold a wooden stick in their right hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Woman Fleeing at the Sight of a Soldier
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.1 x 23.8 cm (6 5/16 x 9 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, showing a densely forested environment. A winding path leads through the woods towards ancient ruins and a large rocky formation on the horizon. The horizon is placed high in the image, with horizontal lines suggesting a quiet sky. The etching technique used gives the scene a detailed appearance, with intricate lines depicting trees, figures, and ruins. In the foreground, a woman dances energetically near a seated figure, possibly playing music. To the right, a man gestures toward the scene near a large tree. The image is in a monochrome palette, dominated by sepia tones highlighting fine linear patterns, giving a classic and timeless quality.

artworks.title: The Madonna of the Rosary
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with a child in her lap. The woman looks down at the child, who has curly hair. Both figures are intricately drawn in a detailed line drawing style. The woman wears a headdress and flowing garment, holding a cross-topped staff. The child clutches her arm. Surrounding them are cloud-like forms and cherubic figures with wings, some holding rosary beads. In the background, more clouds and angelic faces are sketched.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over red chalk over leadpoint, reworked with reed pen and brown ink
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated bearded figure holding an orb. The figure appears muscular, with a beard merging into long hair. The face is not detailed, and draped fabric covers part of the body. There is no jewelry, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Fruit Tree in Bloom
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image features a tree viewed from a side perspective, showcasing the intricate structure of the tree with long, cascading branches. The horizon is not defined in the composition, as the focus is on the tree itself with its drooping branches covering much of the visual field. The drawing is done in a sketch-like style using dark, expressive lines on a textured, muted blue-green background. The brushstrokes are loose, creating a sense of natural movement in the branches and foliage. The color palette is dominated by dark lines against the subdued blue-green paper, emphasizing the tree's form and texture while creating a serene yet slightly somber visual impact.

artworks.title: Le Déluge Universel
artworks.artist: Jacques Bonnefoy after Michel Honoré Bounieu
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eda Levitine in memory of George Levitine
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals: a man, a woman, and a child. The man is standing on a rock in the sea, covering his eyes with his right arm. He has dark, tousled hair. The woman is seated on the rock, draped in a white cloth, holding the child close to her chest. The child, also wrapped in a cloth, is young. Waves lap against the rock. In the background, one person is emerging from the water. The scene includes a vast sea under a cloudy sky, with a small boat on the horizon.
